Adds fixed-point comb_filter_const_sse4_1() and comb_filter_overlap_sse4_1() (the whole 120-sample crossfade), bit-exact with the C loops (four 16x32 Q15 products per two pmuldq, mult16_32_q15_sse4_1() in x86cpu.h).
Adds mult16_32_q15_sse4_1() and mult16_32_q16_sse4_1(): MULT16_32_Q15() and MULT16_32_Q16() on four lanes from two pmuldq.
Declares only the implemented API: no create/destroy (no heap), float or 24-bit entry points, DRED, soft clipping, repacketizer, packet padding or opus_decoder_get_nb_samples().
The encoder documentation describes the voice profile.
opus_encode() and opus_decode() take caller scratch memory of OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES as their last argument; the library never uses alloca.

SILK_DECODER_SCRATCH_BYTES and SILK_ENCODER_SCRATCH_BYTES, the sizes of the caller-owned scratch arena (proved by _Static_asserts in dec_API.c and enc_API.c); silk_Decode() and silk_Encode() take the arena as a trailing argument.
The comfort noise buffer is a fixed local array of MAX_FRAME_LENGTH + MAX_LPC_ORDER samples instead of an ALLOC (length is at most MAX_FRAME_LENGTH).

Eight outputs per step with pmaddwd on sample pairs; the 32-bit sums wrap modulo 2^32 exactly like the scalar silk_SMLABB chain, the last block overlaps the previous one (every output depends on the input only) and the scalar loop covers len - d < 8.
The unused USE_CELT_FIR path is removed.
err_Q24, RD_Q25, tempIndices1 and tempIndices2 are fixed local arrays sized by NLSF_VQ_MAX_VECTORS and NLSF_MSVQ_MAX_SURVIVORS (define.h) instead of ALLOCs.

silk_PLC() and silk_PLC_conceal() take the scratch arena; exc_buf is a fixed local array of 2 * MAX_SUB_FRAME_LENGTH samples instead of an ALLOC.

The LPC synthesis is silk_LPC_synthesis(): taps 0 and 1 scalar, taps 2..15 a vector dot product over a sliding history of the samples split into signed high and low 16-bit halves. Exact, because (x * a) >> 16 = hi * a + ((lo * a) >> 16) with lo unsigned; sums wrap in 32 bits like the scalar silk_SMLAWB chain. SILK decode 30,872 -> 25,168 cycles per frame.
silk_decoder_control and the pulses buffer (MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples, the largest padded frame) are fixed locals instead of ALLOCs; the scratch arena goes to silk_decode_core() and silk_PLC().
The sample rate, subframe count and frame length checks use celt_packet_check().
NLSF_MSVQ_MAX_SURVIVORS (16), the largest survivor count silk_setup_complexity() sets.

silk_Encode() takes the scratch arena (SILK_ENCODER_SCRATCH_BYTES, proved by _Static_asserts over the four call paths); the per-frame scratch overlaps the input buffer, which is dead once the frame is resampled into the encoder state.
One frame per call (20 ms, or 10 ms for the prefill): multi-frame LBRR flags, per-block bit shaping and the in-packet bit balance are removed.
No reduced-dependency mode.

abs_pulses, sum_pulses and nRshifts are fixed local arrays sized for MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples instead of ALLOCs (a frame has at most MAX_FRAME_LENGTH samples, so iter * SHELL_CODEC_FRAME_LENGTH fits).
silk_autocorr() takes the scratch arena and passes it to _celt_autocorr().

silk_encode_frame_FIX() and silk_LBRR_encode_FIX() take the scratch arena. The LBRR pass uses the rate loop's first NSQ state copy as its scratch NSQ state instead of an ALLOC: that copy is filled only after the LBRR call.
silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8(), silk_NSQ() and silk_NSQ_del_dec() are called without the arch argument.
LPC_res is a fixed local array of 2 * (MAX_SUB_FRAME_LENGTH + MAX_LPC_ORDER) samples instead of an ALLOC.
Wsig is a fixed local array of FIND_PITCH_LPC_WIN_MAX samples instead of an ALLOC; the scratch arena goes to silk_autocorr() and silk_pitch_analysis_core().
LPC_in_pre, xXLTP_Q17 and XXLTP_Q17 are fixed local arrays sized for the largest subframe count and LPC order instead of ALLOCs; the scratch arena is passed on.
The prototypes of the encoder functions take the scratch arena.
x_windowed is a fixed local array of SHAPE_LPC_WIN_MAX samples instead of an ALLOC; the scratch arena goes to silk_autocorr().
silk_pitch_analysis_core() takes the scratch arena (SILK_PITCH_SCRATCH_BYTES, proved by a _Static_assert); the stage helpers' scratch_mem buffer is a fixed local array.
silk_resampler_down2_3() receives the scratch arena.
LPC_res is a fixed local array of (MAX_NB_SUBFR / 2) * (MAX_SUB_FRAME_LENGTH + MAX_LPC_ORDER) samples instead of an ALLOC.
silk_inner_prod16_c() removed: silk_inner_prod16() is the SSE4.1 kernel of x86/vector_ops_FIX_sse4_1.c.
silk_scale_vector32_Q26_lshift_18() (unused) removed.

No x86/main_sse.h (deleted): the build requires OPUS_X86_PRESUME_SSE4_1 (#error otherwise), and silk_NSQ(), silk_NSQ_del_dec(), silk_VQ_WMat_EC(), silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8() and silk_VAD_GetNoiseLevels() are declared directly, without the _c names, arch dispatch macros and OVERRIDE_ layers.

silk_NSQ(), silk_NSQ_del_dec() and silk_stereo_LR_to_MS() take the scratch arena; SILK_NSQ_SCRATCH_BYTES is the size they need (proved by _Static_asserts in NSQ.c, NSQ_del_dec_sse4_1.c and enc_API.c).

silk_resampler_private_IIR_FIR() and silk_resampler_private_down_FIR() take the scratch arena.

The interpolation computes four outputs per step: one pmaddwd of the eight samples with the eight taps of the position, then _mm_hadd_epi32; exact, because the taps of a position sum to 32768 or less, so no 32-bit overflow. The scalar loop finishes the remainder.
silk_resampler_private_IIR_FIR() takes the scratch arena that its ALLOC draws from.
silk_resampler_private_down_FIR() takes the scratch arena that its ALLOC draws from.

silk_resampler_frac_FIR_12 is [ 12 ][ 8 ]: row t holds the four taps of fraction t followed by those of fraction 11 - t in reverse order, which are the same values upstream reads from two table rows, so one vector load replaces the indexed reads.
silk_resampler_frac_FIR_12 is declared [ 12 ][ RESAMPLER_ORDER_FIR_12 ] (eight taps per fractional position, see resampler_rom.c).
silk_stereo_LR_to_MS() takes the scratch arena that its ALLOCs draw from.
silk_PLC_struct loses enable_deep_plc.
silk_NSQ_del_dec_sse4_1() is renamed silk_NSQ_del_dec() and takes the scratch arena; the C twin NSQ_del_dec.c is deleted (the build requires SSE4.1, so it never ran).

The quantizer decision is branchless: a per-frame table (silk_nsq_candidate_table) holds the q1, q2 and rate-distortion terms by q1_Q0, and dither and swap masks replace the sign and rd1 < rd2 branches; all values are the ones the upstream branches select.

The warped shaping filter keeps its states side by side and sums the noise feedback as one vector dot product (AR coefficients zero past the order): same additions, reordered exactly within 32-bit wraparound.
The per-sample sample-state array is a fixed local array instead of an ALLOC.
silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8_sse4_1() is renamed silk_VAD_GetSA_Q8() and loses the arch argument; the band buffer X is a fixed local array of MAX_FRAME_LENGTH + MAX_FRAME_LENGTH / 4 samples instead of an ALLOC.
silk_VQ_WMat_EC_sse4_1() is renamed silk_VQ_WMat_EC() and loses the arch argument; its C twin VQ_WMat_EC.c is deleted, because the build requires SSE4.1 and the C version never ran.
opus_packet_parse() implements parsing without self-delimited framing, padding output or packet offset (multistream and extensions only); encode_size() removed.
Requests limited to reset, gain and final range; the complexity (deep PLC), bandwidth, sample rate, pitch, last packet duration, phase inversion and extension requests are removed.
No create/destroy, opus_decode24(), DRED or packet extension parsing; opus_decode_native() is private.

The decoded frame size checks use celt_packet_check(); the unreachable bandwidth fallback checks are removed (the TOC byte yields only NB/MB/WB for SILK-only and one of the five bandwidths otherwise).

opus_decode() takes the caller's scratch (OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES) and passes it through opus_decode_native() and opus_decode_frame() to SILK and CELT; a static assertion checks the decoder's worst case against OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES.
Reduced to the voice profile: 48 kHz, VOIP, one 20 ms VBR frame per packet, 16-bit input. Packets are bit-identical to upstream for these settings.

Removed: multi-frame repacketizing, CBR padding, the AUDIO and restricted applications, forced mode, bandwidth and channels, signal and voice ratio hints, LFE, surround masking, tonality analysis, float and 24-bit input, create/destroy.
Requests: bitrate, complexity, in-band FEC (0 or 1), packet loss, DTX, VBR constraint, lookahead, final range and reset.

opus_encode() takes the caller's scratch (OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES) and passes it through opus_encode_native() and opus_encode_frame_native() to SILK and CELT; a static assertion checks the encoder's worst case against OPUS_SCRATCH_BYTES.
Keeps the mode constants and align(); repacketizer, extension, multistream and private encoder/decoder declarations removed.
